sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Trump threatens to seize Kharg Island, launch "more ferocious" strikes on Iran tonight; U.S.-Iran conflict enters its third night: Trump posted that the U.S. "will take Kharg Island and other oil infrastructure in the near future, fully taking over Iran's oil and gas market, just like we did with Venezuela," and said tonight's strikes would be "very hard"; he later walked it back, saying he was unsure whether "the U.S. has the appetite for this." Kharg Island handles about 90% of Iran's crude oil exports. Strangely, oil prices were unmoved—USO is currently -0.8%, XOM flat, while SPY is +0.68% at $730.55 and QQQ has surged +1.69% to $705. The combination of "war escalation + market rally + falling oil prices" has left the entire community questioning reality.
  • PPI blows out, but the market rises anyway: May final demand PPI was +1.1% MoM and +6.5% YoY, with the goods component +2.8%, the fastest pace since 2022; bulls seized on "cooler core PPI (services only +0.3%)" to make their case. On top of yesterday's hot CPI, the narrative that "the Fed will be forced hawkish" continued to build, but after the open, indices still gapped higher and kept climbing.
  • ECB hikes rates for the first time in nearly three years: The deposit rate was raised from 2% to 2.25%, explicitly attributed to the Iran war pushing up energy prices and eurozone inflation at 3.2%, far above target, with staff forecasting 2026 full-year inflation at 3%. Global central banks being forced back onto a tightening path by war-driven inflation is the latest hard evidence for the community's bearish "rates reprice everything" thesis.
  • SpaceX IPO prices tonight, lists tomorrow: Fixed price of $135/share, valuation of $1.75T, raising $75B (the largest IPO in history), with demand exceeding $250B (3.5-4x oversubscribed), and an unusually high retail allocation of up to 30%. On the same day, Iranian state media announced that Musk's Middle East companies would be listed as military targets. Virgin Galactic (SPCE), benefiting from ticker confusion, is currently +16.7%, with the surge in "fake SpaceX" becoming the joke of the day.
  • Software and AI giants keep getting slaughtered, while storage/semiconductors rip in one direction: ORCL is currently -10.5% to $180 after earnings and dilution fallout; MSFT -1.2% ($392.65, -14.6% on the month, down roughly 10 consecutive days), GOOGL -1.6% below the $350 level, META -1.3%, and CRM/ADBE/SAP all down 2-3%. On the other side, SNDK +8.1%, AMD +5.6%, MU +3.8% at $927, INTC surging +10.6% after a double upgrade from BofA, and SOXL +15.6%. The sector rotation of "sell software, buy memory" has reached an extreme.

社区氛围：总体来说，社区处于一种“屡打耳光后习得性混乱”的状态——大多数人本能看空（战争+PPI火热+加息+IPO流动性流失），但连续第四天的“跳空V型反弹”让他们不敢下注。看跌期权人群不断爆发，看涨期权人群不敢追涨，而投票最多的情绪是“无法交易”和“只能观望直到 SpaceX 落地”。方向性信念已跌至本周最低水平。

恐惧/贪婪估计：评论提到恐惧和贪婪大约27（恐惧区）；社区情绪在 35/100 左右——表面上是恐惧，但内心深处，“SPCX 资金回流”的贪婪预期和 TACO 不可避免的出现正在激动人心。

情绪与实际价格走势：市场普遍预期“开盘→10点后抛售”（连续多日出现），但截至10点06分，开盘后前期探底（SPY低点726.37）已经V型收复，创出盘中新高，再次压垮看跌期权持有者——“WSB 90%都是看跌期权，所以必须上涨”的逆逻辑曾经一度出现过。再次发挥出来。
